name: Marine Hazards
description: Overview, concept and classification of marine and coastal hazards and their physical, chemical and biological drivers; Spatio-temporal scales of marine hazards; Rip currents, Ocean waves and rogue waves; Tsunami – generation, propagation, modelling and early warning systems; Tropical Cyclones and storm surges –dynamics and coastal flooding; Marine heatwaves: detection, classification and ecosystem impacts; Harmful algal blooms and red tides; Marine Pollution and Oil spills: transport, dispersion of pollutants and environmental consequences; Ocean acidification and its implications for marine systems; Coastal hazards including sea-level rise, erosion and vulnerability assessment; Modelling and Prediction of marine hazards using satellite remote sensing, in-situ platforms (satellites, buoys, HF Radars, etc.) and numerical models.
